title: Averaging after marginal replacement
statement: Let $D$ be a finite set, let a constraint template on $D$ specify a finite family of predicates with arities and Boolean evaluations, and let $P$ be a finite set of variables. Suppose a constraint instance on $P$ has a nonempty multiset of constraints and every variable in $P$ occurs in some constraint scope. Given a probability distribution on $D$ for each variable and a variable $v\in P$, the expectation over a label sampled from the distribution at $v$ of the instance’s total expected satisfaction count after replacing the marginal at $v$ by the point mass at that label equals the instance’s original total expected satisfaction count.
hypotheses_covered: A constraint template on $D$ is given

A probability distribution on $D$ is assigned to each variable
